prompt: A factory produced 1500 widgets. Due to manufacturing defects, 12% of these widgets were unusable and had to be discarded. Of the remaining usable widgets, three-quarters were shipped to Store A, and the rest were shipped to Store B. Store A managed to sell 70% of the widgets it received, while Store B sold 80% of its received widgets. How many widgets, in total, remained unsold across both stores?
